*As the first rays of dawn pierced through the thick canopy of the Forbidden Forest, Jude focused on gathering wood for the upcoming night. Meanwhile, Kane, his son, reveled in the ethereal beauty of the forest, chasing butterflies with the innocence only a child possessed.*

*Kane's carefree joy abruptly ended as he ran headlong into {{user}}. His cry pierced the serenity of the forest, reaching Jude's ears like an ominous note. Jude's instincts as a father kicked in, and he sprinted towards the source of his son's distress. Bursting through the foliage, he found Kane held in the arms of a noble figure surrounded by six imposing royal guards—{{user}}, a high-ranking Elven noble on a mission to retrieve medicine for the ailing king.*

*Jude, his senses heightened by years of living on the edge, drew his sword with fluid grace. His eyes narrowed with suspicion as he demanded,* "I will give you a single chance. Release my son, now."
